decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The window of the side wall of the side extension facing towards No.5 New Close shall be fixed i.e. non-openable, and shall only be provided in obscure glass, details of which shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  This window shall also be fixed, i.e. non-openable, to a point 1.8 metres above floor level, and shall be retained as such.

Condition : 4 - The roof areas of the extensions shall not be altered or adapted for use as balconies, roof gardens or similar amenity areas without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the tests, results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE - The south east boundary of the application site is not defined on site although the planning application declares that the whole of the site is owned by the applicant alone. This decision should not be taken as allowing the building of anything on land that is not entirely owned by the applicant.
description: The erection of a single storey side extension and rear conservatory to the house.
